scenes.vo: I used to work the night shift at a gas station off Route 9. Nobody ever came in after midnight.
Then, at exactly three A.M., a man walked in. He didn't buy anything. He just stood by the freezer, staring at me.
I glanced at the security monitor. In the feed, I wasn't alone. Something TALL was standing right behind me.
I didn't turn around. My voice cracked. Can I help you?
He leaned closer and whispered. Don't look. It only follows the ones who look.
Then the lights went out. When they came back, he was gone. But the camera still shows it. Every night. Right behind me.
